/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('The server does NOT ignore unknown types: it replies with an "'`error` carrying code `INVALID_MESSAGE` (Section 5.6).'"','The server does NOT ignore unknown types: it replies with an "'`error` carrying code `INVALID_MESSAGE` (Section 5.6) ([validated by: rejects a message type inherited by ordinary objects](../../src/transport/ws/validationDispatch.test.ts#L5)).'"')
section='''### 4.3 list_sessions

A client requests conversation metadata with a "'`list_sessions` frame; the server uses the authenticated session'"'s user id, ignores a supplied "'`userId`, and does not end a turn when it answers ([validated by: answers list_sessions for the authenticated user with ISO dates, forwarding limit and before while ignoring any client userId](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L72)).

```json
{"type":"list_sessions","limit":10,"before":{"updatedAt":"2026-01-01T00:05:00.000Z","sessionId":"s3"}}
```

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | Yes | `"list_sessions"` |
| `limit` | non-negative integer | No | Maximum rows requested; `0` asks for none |
| `before` | object | No | Cursor containing `updatedAt` and `sessionId` |
| `before.updatedAt` | string or number | When `before` is present | Parseable timestamp or finite epoch milliseconds |
| `before.sessionId` | string | When `before` is present | Session id of 1–128 characters |

Malformed paging fields receive `INVALID_MESSAGE` without calling the store ([validated by: accepts a bare list_sessions frame and rejects a malformed limit or before with INVALID_MESSAGE without calling listFor](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L142)).

'"'''
s=s.replace('## 5. Server-to-Client Messages',section+'## 5. Server-to-Client Messages')
section2='''### 5.9 session_list

The server answers "'`list_sessions` with one `session_list` frame containing only the authenticated user'"'s conversation summaries; each summary has "'`sessionId`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, and `entryCount`, and the two times are ISO-8601 strings ([validated by: answers list_sessions for the authenticated user with ISO dates, forwarding limit and before while ignoring any client userId](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L72)).

```json
{"type":"session_list","sessions":[{"sessionId":"s2","createdAt":"2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z","updatedAt":"2026-01-01T00:02:00.000Z","entryCount":4}]}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string | `"session_list"` |
| `sessions` | array | Conversation summaries for the authenticated user |
| `sessions[].sessionId` | string | Conversation id |
| `sessions[].createdAt` | string | ISO-8601 creation time |
| `sessions[].updatedAt` | string | ISO-8601 last activity time |
| `sessions[].entryCount` | number | Number of entries |

The frame contains metadata and no conversation content; a client can reconnect with a listed id using `?sessionId=<id>` when resume is enabled ([validated by: carries only its four fields, so a list can never hand over a conversation or a credential](../../src/infrastructure/stores/sessionStoreListSignature.test.ts#L22)).

'"'''
s=s.replace('## 6. SessionEntry Objects',section2+'## 6. SessionEntry Objects')
p.write_text(s)
PY"
